label: copy phase, mid-recall, a k or r is about to be output (within ~3 steps)
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (99.8% of mass). It is essentially silent during the original tokens, at the delimiter, and on the first two recalls; most mass falls at recall_idx 3-5 with 1-4 outputs remaining. The strongest activations come one to three steps before the model has to output k or r: out_tok k/r has 6x lift, next_out r has 7x, and the top examples sit right before runs like k r r. Where the predicate holds, the feature is active only about 28% of the time. There is also a broad, weak background on other mid-copy steps that no token-level predicate captured; it accounts for about half the mass and mostly makes up the lower quartiles. The input token, digit count and repeat counts barely matter.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the next token to output (most: r, l, d, o, s, k; least: y, 1, 0, q) and the token being output (most: k, r, o, p, w, 2; least: q, -, y, 0); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4, L=9.
